summary: Verified PLAN-20260817-0002 complete against its six scope items, each with its evidence. ITEM 1, output digest primitive: outcome.output_text_digest is schema-optional in invocation_record.py, populated by outcome_block in invocation_capture.py from outcome.text, the same immutable value assigned to answer in compare_providers.py and incorporated verbatim into the artifact; exact-byte round-trip tests cover leading/trailing whitespace and fence-like content, and two live digests exist. ITEM 2, per-section attribution: build_markdown_artifact writes a retained invocation_id line for each response captured with a record; COMP-0141 carries two. ITEM 3, pure evaluator: ai_lab.provenance.produced_by.evaluate_produced_by. ITEM 4, establishment condition: canonical InvocationRecord validation, an exact seeded triple (artifact's retained comparison_id, produced_by, record's invocation_id), exactly one attributed section, and digest equality over exactly-extracted bytes; every other state is unresolved with one of nine enumerated reasons. ITEM 5, completion instance: the deliberate two-provider run produced COMP-0141 with both relations established, one per successfully captured response. ITEM 6, falsification and mutation suite: 30 falsification tests and 8 mutation tests, full suite 822. DIRECTION CORRECTION, RECORDED RATHER THAN REWRITTEN. The predicate registry defines produced_by with the artifact as source and the invocation as target: COMP produced_by INV. The admitted plan and warrant repeatedly used the shorthand 'invocation-to-artifact produced_by', which is directionally wrong; invocation-to-artifact ancestry is the registered inverse, produces. No predicate, seed, or implementation direction changes: the code inspects the existing artifact-produced_by-invocation seeds. The admitted records are not edited; this paragraph is the correction of record, and mutable code documentation and capability records now state the direction correctly. DEFECTS FOUND AFTER IMPLEMENTATION, ALL RETAINED. First, the seed-direction/fictional-fixture pair found by the deliberate run (703471b). Second, the completion review found two establishment holes in the corrected evaluator: establishment of a record the canonical validator rejects, and acceptance of a seed whose source_id names a different artifact; both reproduced, fixed at 312d08b, falsified, and mutation-tested. Third, adding canonical validation exposed that the test fixtures themselves did not validate: invocation_id is content-addressed over identity fields, so fixtures cannot invent ids and now derive them via invocation_id_for exactly as the system does — the third fixture-vs-reality instance this slice, each recorded at its site. HISTORICAL EVIDENCE, MEASURED. Canonical parsing of the 106 historical invocation_produced_by blocks yields 212 seed references to 212 distinct retained InvocationRecords (210 JSON-parseable plus 2 in the repr-era COMP-0035): 182 evaluate no_outcome_block and 30 outcome_without_output_digest. The earlier packaging-executor regex sweep returned 213 because it also matched a prose citation in COMP-0038 to an InvocationRecord actually seeded by COMP-0037; the 212-versus-213 discrepancy recorded unresolved in the admitted plan's amendment block is therefore resolved here as a counting-method artifact, not a duplicate produced_by relation, and the admitted plan is not edited. No historical evaluation reaches seed parsing, because record evidence is checked first. Exactly one artifact, COMP-0035, carries the legacy Python-repr seed serialization; a digest-bearing record evaluated against it would refuse with the enumerated reason invalid_seed_metadata, and no such record exists. Nothing historical is promoted or retrofitted, and the evaluator never reads a seed's authoritative flag. FRAMING CHANGES, OPERATOR-APPROVED. markdown_escape_fence lengthens the fence until its backtick run cannot occur in the content it fences; the prior single escalation was falsified by content containing both fence strings (approval recorded 2026-08-20). PROCESS NOTE. During completion-record transport, superseded draft capability amendments referencing this then-uncommitted verification record were committed ahead of it (7d092a2), failed the seed audit, and were reverted at c0dbb30 before any warrant referenced them; the zip-extraction transport can resurrect stale files and the corrected records ship only after this verification exists. BOUNDARIES THAT REMAIN TRUE. Both edge classes required for an invocation-to-artifact-to-invocation chain are implemented; no governed instance exists in which an artifact established as produced_by is also consumed through a ContextManifest edge, so no composable path is claimed. No traversal, no EDGE persistence, no C3 or C10 enforcement claim.
